findings: Observation, hypothesis, experiment and automation interact; human goals remain necessary.
Formal checking can verify a mistranslated hypothesis; generated code can falsify selected cases without proving the real scientific claim.
Success, novelty, repetition and model agreement do not supply calibrated scientific confidence.
Reasoning, planning, self-correction, interpretation and peer review have stated limitations; negative results are valuable.
limitations: No model, downloaded code, package or bank experiment executed.
Figures not visually inspected; image allowance exhausted.
Algorithmic confidence is a proposed research direction without a validated general construction.
